evidence_type: Assistant transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver result screenshot; no direct database read.

analysis_window.scope: Global product unit totals across all 10 source stores and all categories, including all 3,049 source products and zero-sales products; the interval is defined by SQL21.

display_normalization: Thousands separators are omitted. Percentage values are represented with four decimal places. Padding trailing zeros preserves displayed numeric values. ZERO_SALES rank bounds remain JSON null and are not replaced with zero. TOTAL rank bounds cover only positive-sales products.
classification_rule: ZERO_SALES first; positives sorted units DESC,item_id ASC. Prior cumulative units*100 < total*80 => A; else <total*95 => B; else C. Crossing SKU remains in the earlier class. Threshold membership uses exact integers.
scope: Learner execution and the five displayed ABC validation rows are accepted for the fixed pre-holdout 90-day window. A, B, C and ZERO_SALES are mutually exclusive and partition TOTAL. A matches the accepted SQL20 80% prefix; A+B matches its 95% prefix. PASS concerns the documented data, persisted-table and classification checks, not business performance. The screenshot does not independently recompute original source hashes or compare every SKU against staging/raw inputs; those are separate assistant preflight evidence. The accompanying business interpretation is explicitly attributed to the assistant. This is a global units-based 80/95 baseline, not monetary, profit, store-level or volatility classification. Threshold sensitivity remains pending, and no optimal threshold, forecasting, inventory, assortment-removal or causal result is claimed.
